opening.argument: The video presents a ranked list of ten branded gift cards, with QVC and Amazon shown as products in that list. It describes what recipients can buy with the cards, from office supplies to books and other ordinary merchandise. Denominations, places of use, replacement rules, fees, and purchase categories are discussed as consumer-product features. These are the terms and uses of retail gift cards, not an offer to participate in a financial arrangement. Nothing in those descriptions establishes promised returns or financial outcomes.
